page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 4 dedicated vCPUs provided by a Hygon 7447v processor operating at a baseline frequency of 2.6 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance type does not include bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It does not feature any graphics processing units (GPUs), making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The ecs.c9h.xlarge instance offers a dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource contention. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it a cost-efficient option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints. Appropriate workloads for this hardware profile include web serving, batch processing, microservices, and lightweight application servers.
